vat_rates.legal_product_description: Value Added Tax at the standard rate of 15% computed on the total price of the item (levies no longer added to the VAT base).
vat_rates.normalized_product_description: standard rate of value added tax on taxable supplies in Ghana
vat_rates.rate_basis: total price of the item (post-reform base — GETFUND/NHIL/COVID levies no longer added before VAT)
vat_rates.legal_reference: Value Added Tax Act, 2025 (Act 1151) — page TVA officielle GRA : « These reforms passed under the Value Added Tax Act, 2025 (Act 1151) took effect from 1st January 2026 »
vat_rates.consolidation_note: Consolidé depuis la page officielle GRA archivée le 2026-09-05 (SHA-256 4e693ade…). La copie du texte de loi (gazette) reste à archiver.
